messages:
aria_support: Customer reports streaming connection drops ~5s after token rotation, getting a 403 mid-stream. Provided request-id r:7f9a2c and a short server log snippet. Asking for a minimal curl reproduction + validation checklist we can hand back.

mike_ops: Got it — can you paste the exact request-id header and the auth TTL? Also, did they use signed cookies or Authorization header?

aria_support: They use Authorization: Bearer <short-lived> (token TTL ~30s). Header from logs: "x-request-id: r:7f9a2c". No cookies.

mike_ops: OK. Minimal curl I usually give for streaming auth rotation repro:

```bash
# replace TOKEN and HOST/ROUTE
curl -v --no-buffer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "x-request-id: r:7f9a2c" \
  --trace-ascii curl-trace.txt \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/chat?stream=true"
```

Add `--ignore-content-length` on older curl builds if chunked EOF occurs. `--no-buffer` is important so you see chunks in real time. The `--trace-ascii` file will capture headers and timing to correlate with our server logs.

sophie_eng: Checklist to validate when you run the snippet:
- Confirm initial 200 handshake and `:status: 200` in trace.
- Verify `x-request-id` echoed by our edge in the first response headers.
- Watch for a 401/403 mid-stream — note the offset (seconds) from the start.
- Correlate curl-trace timestamps with server log timestamps (request-id).
- If it fails on token rotate, repeat with a token refreshed at client side right before TTL expiry to confirm race window.
- Capture full server side logs for the request-id and include env (region, model, backend host).

mike_ops: A couple of extra tips:
- If the client is auto-refreshing tokens, try two variants: (A) static token issued 60s before test; (B) token issued 5s before test to simulate rotation.
- Use `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.example:443 -tlsextdebug` only if you suspect TLS renegotiation.
- For Windows cURL, add `--raw` to avoid CRLF conversions.

tracebot: [deploy-bot] rollout to prod/edge-12 completed at 2026-03-10T14:32:00Z :white_check_mark:

aria_support: Collected curl-trace.txt and server logs for r:7f9a2c and uploaded to the debug bundle (link pasted privately). Quick test showed disconnect ~6.1s after handshake, matching the customer's observation.

sophie_eng: When you paste the trace, include the first 200ms of the TCP handshake + first 10s of application-layer exchange. Also export the trace-ascii with timestamps (`curl --trace-time`). That makes matching trivial.

mike_ops: Final reproduction validation steps to give back to customer:
1) Run the snippet with `--trace-time --no-buffer --trace-ascii` and attach file.
2) Confirm `x-request-id` present in both client trace and our logs.
3) Try variant with `Connection: keep-alive` and explicit `Expect:` removal to see if intermediary proxies are closing idle streams.
4) If repro is consistent, try `--header "Authorization: Bearer <longer-ttl-token>"` to confirm TTL is root cause.

aria_support: Perfect — I will send those steps + the sanitized trace back. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
